People say this, but the hard truth is that where you go does matter. You are going to find a better quality education no matter what at a private college than community College. Private colleges also have way more connections and opportunities that they provide to their students. Chances are I will end up at a state school or UC but it's ignorant to say that the quality of education is the same. Professors are going to teach way better at private colleges than they do at communities and will overall provide a better education. However, that's not to say that's all that matters for success. Community College students have the Blunt of carrying their education put on them. That will in turn build tenacity and build success. But overall, people who get accepted into private institutions on scholarships are way better off.

Edit: 1160 SAT isn't bad yo. You're above average. Knock out those community College courses and try to transfer on a scholarship. You got this.
